title: HAG: Hierarchical Demographic Tree-based Agent Generation for Topic-Adaptive Simulation
measurement_description: Inclusion of religion as a demographic attribute in the generation and evaluation of synthetic populations. The framework aimed to create sociologically consistent agent personas, where religion was one of twelve dimensions of cultural identity and socio-economic status.
findings: The paper included 'Religion' as one of twelve key demographic dimensions for generating synthetic agent populations, based on the World Values Survey. However, the paper does not report any specific findings, performance metrics, or biases related to the religion attribute itself; results are aggregated across all demographic dimensions.
